title: Finite reductions of completed perfect models on the original chart
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be an immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $(A,I)$ an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and $B_X=\varprojlim_n(A/I^{n+1})_X$ the actual completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_X))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $U$ be an object of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $C^\bullet$ be a complex of finite projective $A$-modules with zero terms outside an integer interval $[a,b]$. Suppose that the restrictions to $U$ of $g^*K$ and of $g^*(B_X\otimes_{\underline A}^L\underline C^\bullet)$ are isomorphic, with the specified constant realization and completed coefficient map [def-weil-pbc-completed-constant-complex-base, def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-derived-restriction]. For $n\ge0$ write $R_n$ for the continuous-function quotient coefficient sheaf and $j_n:\underline{A/I^{n+1}}\simeq R_n$ for its canonical constant comparison. Then the restriction to the same $U$ of $g^*\operatorname{Res}_{j_n}(K\otimes_{B_X}^LR_n)$ is isomorphic to that of $g^*\underline{(A/I^{n+1})\otimes_A C^\bullet}$ for every $n\ge0$. No refinement of $U$ is made.

proof.text: For any weakly etale chart U, the slice site is equivalent to the small pro-etale site of U. Transport module sheaves along this equivalence. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies geometric module inverse image, followed by this equivalence, with slice restriction. These exact equivalences descend to derived categories.

For a coefficient map φ:R→S, geometric derived pullback commutes with derived extension. Indeed, the opposite restriction/direct-image square commutes; compose their scalar and geometric adjunctions and use uniqueness of left adjoints. Apply this twice, for g and for U→Y. Full faithfulness of the derived slice equivalence transports any local isomorphism through scalar extension.

Write c for the constant-to-completed map, p for its n-th projection and j for the constant-to-continuous quotient-ring isomorphism. The limit-projection equation gives cp=βj, where β is the constant quotient map. Restriction along j equals extension along j inverse, by the ring-isomorphism module equivalence and uniqueness of derived left adjoints. Tensor associativity therefore reduces the normalized completed model to derived extension along β of the constant C.

The constant C is bounded above and termwise flat since its terms are projective. It is K-flat, so the universal scalar-extension counit computes extension along β termwise. The constant-realization tensor comparison is an isomorphism in each degree and commutes with the differentials; localizing it gives the constant quotient tensor complex. Compose with the transported local model isomorphism.

theorem perfect_chart_tensor_comparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsImmersion g]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (K : d.derived X) (U : Y.ProEt)
    (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
    (_ha : C.IsStrictlyGE a) (hb : C.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hC : ∀ q, Module.Projective A (C.X q) ∧ Module.Finite A (C.X q))
    (e : Nonempty (integralLocalDerived g (d.completedRing X) U K ≅
      integralLocalDerived g (d.completedRing X) U
        ((pbcDerivedExtend (CompletedConstantReduction.base X d.ideal ≫
          (pbcCompletedComparison X d).hom)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((CompletedConstantReduction.constantComplex X A).obj C))))) :
    ∀ n,
      letI := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))).left_adjoint_additive
      Nonempty (integralLocalDerived g
      (adicLisseConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))) U
        ((pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom).obj
          ((d.reduction X n).obj K)) ≅
      integralLocalDerived g (adicLisseConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))) U
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((CompletedConstantReduction.constantComplex X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).obj
            (((ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.mk
              (d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C))))
